question: Can any experience be entirely free from both auspicious and inauspicious qualities?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious experiences arise together
Nothing experienced is devoid of them
inference: All experiences necessarily contain a mixture of auspicious and inauspicious qualities.
uncertainties: saṃbhoktaṃ may be read as experienced or to be experienced
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things are to be experienced, and nowhere is anything devoid of them.
